title: ClearML SNUG whitelist (v1)
description: v1 whitelist. The executioner serializes the inline agent.snug.whitelist config block and hands it to the shim base64-encoded via the CLEARML_SNUG_WHITELIST env var. Schema is locked at v1; any field change requires a schema version bump.

version.description: Schema version. v1 only in this release.

default_action.description: Behavior for hosts with no matching rule. 'meter' counts bytes; 'ignore' passes through untouched.

rules.description: Evaluated in order; first match wins.

host.description: Host pattern matched case-insensitively against the Host header. A leading and/or trailing '*' makes it a wildcard: '*.anthropic.com' (suffix), 'api.anthropic.*' (prefix), '*anthropic*' (substring), '*' (any host). No '*' means an exact match. Only a boundary '*' is special; a '*' in the middle is literal.

path_prefix.description: Matched against the request-target path component.

inject_headers.description: Whether to splice 'project:' and 'session:' headers into outbound HTTP/1.x requests.
